findings.issue: Loans are disbursed into the LSP's account, not the borrower's bank account.
findings.doc_evidence: Disbursement of loan by the RE shall always be made into the bank account of the borrower except for disbursals covered exclusively under statutory or regulatory mandate (of RBI or of any other regulator), flow of money between REs for co-lending transactions 6 and disbursals for specific end use, provided the loan is disbursed directly into the bank account of the end-beneficiary 7 .

findings.issue: Repayment is executed through the LSP's account, not directly into the RE's bank account.
findings.doc_evidence: RE shall ensure that all loan servicing, repayment, etc. is executed by the borrower directly in the RE’s bank account without any pass-through account/ pool account of any third party, including the accounts of LSP.

findings.issue: No cooling-off period is provided, violating the requirement for an explicit option to exit a digital loan during an initial cooling-off period.
findings.doc_evidence: The borrower shall be given an explicit option to exit a digital loan by paying the principal and the proportionate APR without any penalty during an initial “cooling-off period”.

findings.issue: Fees, charges, etc., payable to LSPs for recovery are not explicitly stated to be paid directly by the RE.
findings.doc_evidence: RE shall ensure that any fees, charges, reimbursements, etc. payable to LSP are paid directly by the RE and are not charged to or collected from the borrowers separately by LSP.

findings.issue: No mention of a one-time processing fee for exiting the loan during the cooling-off period, which is required if applicable.
findings.doc_evidence: RE may retain a reasonable one-time processing fee, if the customer exits the loan during the cooling-off period. This, if applicable, shall be disclosed to the customer upfront in KFS.

findings.issue: Data is processed in Ireland, which may not be explicitly consented to, and the audit trail is not mentioned.
findings.doc_evidence: RE shall ensure that any collection of data by their DLA and DLA of their LSP is need-based and with prior and explicit consent of the borrower having audit trail.
